name: Alice: Love & Labyrinth
source:
First installment in Koyonplete's Alice series.

You can choose your love interest from 3 charismatic characters with distinctive personalities; the White Rabbit, the Cheshire Cat and the Hatter!

Beware; the Queen’s murderer could be among one of them. Keep silent for love or fight for justice, it’s all up to you! Try deducing the truth, and through the truth you shall find your own path.

[Source: Official Google Play description]
translation:
Koyonplete「愛麗絲」系列的第一部作品。

你可以從三名個性鮮明、魅力十足的角色中選擇戀愛對象：白兔、柴郡貓與瘋帽匠！

小心，殺害女王的兇手可能就在他們之中。為了愛情保持沉默，還是為了正義挺身而出，全由你決定！試著推理真相，從中找出屬於自己的道路。

[來源：Google Play官方簡介]
